people.descriptor: Son of King Yuan of Chu

units.zh: 孝景皇帝者，孝文之中子也。
units.en: Emperor Jing was the middle son of Emperor Wen.
units.literal: Emperor Xiaojing was the middle son of Emperor Xiaowen.

units.en: His mother was Empress Dowager Dou.
units.literal: His mother was Empress Dowager Dou.

units.zh: 孝文在代時，前后有三男，及竇太后得幸，前后死，及三子更死，故孝景得立。
units.en: While Emperor Wen was still in Dai, he had three sons by his former consort. After Lady Dou won his favor, that consort died, and the three sons died in turn as well. This was how Emperor Jing came to be named heir.
units.literal: When Emperor Xiaowen was in Dai, he had three sons by his former queen. After Empress Dowager Dou gained his favor, the former queen died, and the three sons also died one after another. Therefore, Emperor Xiaojing was able to be established.

units.en: In the fourth month of his first year, on the yimao day, he granted a general amnesty throughout the empire.
units.literal: In the fourth month of the first year, on the yimao day, he granted amnesty to all under Heaven.

units.en: On the yisi day, he granted the common people one grade of noble rank.
units.literal: On the yisi day, he bestowed one grade of noble rank on the people.

units.zh: 五月，除田半租，為孝文立太宗廟。
units.en: In the fifth month, he abolished the half-tax on agricultural land and established the Taizong temple for Emperor Wen.
units.literal: In the fifth month, he abolished the half land tax and established the Taizong temple for Emperor Xiaowen.

units.en: He ordered the ministers to dispense with the court congratulations ceremony.
units.literal: He ordered the assembled ministers not to offer court congratulations.

units.en: The Xiongnu invaded Dai, and he made peace with them through a heqin marriage alliance.
units.literal: The Xiongnu entered Dai, and he made a treaty of heqin with them.

units.zh: 二年春，封故相國蕭何孫系為武陵侯。
units.en: In the spring of his second year, he enfeoffed Xi, grandson of the former Chancellor Xiao He, as Marquis of Wuling.
units.literal: In spring of the second year, he enfeoffed Xi, grandson of the former Chancellor Xiao He, as Marquis of Wuling.

units.en: Men became liable for service registration at age twenty.
units.literal: Males received service registration at twenty.

units.en: On the renwu day of the fourth month, Empress Dowager Xiaowen passed away.
units.literal: In the fourth month, on the renwu day, Empress Dowager Xiaowen died.

units.en: The Kings of Guangchuan and Changsha both went to their fiefs.
units.literal: The Kings of Guangchuan and Changsha both went to their states.

units.en: Chancellor Shentu Jia passed away.
units.literal: Chancellor Shentu Jia died.

units.zh: 八月，以御史大夫開封陶青為丞相。
units.en: In the eighth month, he appointed Tao Qing of Kaifeng, the Grandee Secretary, as Chancellor.
units.literal: In the eighth month, he made Tao Qing of Kaifeng, the Grandee Secretary, Chancellor.

units.en: A comet appeared in the northeast.
units.literal: A comet appeared in the northeast.

units.zh: 秋，衡山雨雹，大者五寸，深者二尺。
units.en: In autumn, hail fell in Hengshan, with the largest stones five cun across and accumulations two chi deep.
units.literal: In autumn, hail fell in Hengshan; the largest stones were five cun, and the deepest accumulation was two chi.

units.en: Mars moved in retrograde motion and lingered near Beichen.
units.literal: Mars moved retrograde and guarded Beichen.

units.en: The moon appeared near Beichen.
units.literal: The moon appeared among Beichen.

units.en: Jupiter moved in retrograde motion within the Heavenly Court constellation.
units.literal: Jupiter moved retrograde within the Heavenly Court.

units.zh: 置南陵及內史、祋祤為縣。
units.en: He established Nanling, Neishi, and Duiyu as counties.
units.literal: He established Nanling, and also Neishi and Duiyu, as counties.

units.en: In the first month of his third year, on the yisi day, he granted a general amnesty throughout the empire.
units.literal: In the first month of the third year, on the yisi day, he granted amnesty to all under Heaven.

units.en: A comet appeared in the west.
units.literal: A long star appeared in the west.

units.zh: 天火燔雒陽東宮大殿城室。
units.en: A fire from the sky consumed the great hall and other buildings in Luoyang's Eastern Palace.
units.literal: Heavenly fire burned the great hall and buildings of the Eastern Palace at Luoyang.

units.zh: 吳王濞、楚王戊、趙王遂、膠西王卬、濟南王辟光、菑川王賢、膠東王雄渠反，發兵西鄉。
units.en: The Kings Bi of Wu, Wu of Chu, Sui of Zhao, Ang of Jiaoxi, Piguang of Jinan, Xian of Zichuan, and Xiongqu of Jiaodong rebelled, raised armies, and marched west.
units.literal: King Bi of Wu, King Wu of Chu, King Sui of Zhao, King Ang of Jiaoxi, King Piguang of Jinan, King Xian of Zichuan, and King Xiongqu of Jiaodong rebelled, raised troops, and faced west.

units.zh: 天子為誅晁錯，遣袁盎諭告，不止，遂西圍梁。
units.en: The emperor executed Chao Cuo on their account and sent Yuan Ang to explain his decision and admonish them. They still did not stop, and went west to besiege Liang.
units.literal: The Son of Heaven executed Chao Cuo for their sake and sent Yuan Ang to explain and admonish them, but they did not stop, and then went west to besiege Liang.

units.zh: 上乃遣大將軍竇嬰、太尉周亞夫將兵誅之。
units.en: The emperor then sent Grand General Dou Ying and Grand Commandant Zhou Yafu to lead troops and suppress the rebellion.
units.literal: The emperor then sent Grand General Dou Ying and Grand Commandant Zhou Yafu to lead troops and punish them.

units.en: On yihai in the sixth month.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the yihai day.

units.zh: 赦亡軍及楚元王子藝等與謀反者。
units.en: He pardoned deserters, along with Yi, son of King Yuan of Chu, and others who had taken part in the conspiracy.
units.literal: He granted amnesty to deserters and to Yi, son of King Yuan of Chu, and the others who had conspired in rebellion.

units.zh: 封大將軍竇嬰為魏其侯。
units.en: He enfeoffed Grand General Dou Ying as the Marquis of Weiqi.
units.literal: Enfeoffed Grand General Dou Ying as Marquis of Weiqi.

units.zh: 立楚元王子平陸侯禮為楚王。
units.en: He installed Li, son of King Yuan of Chu and Marquis of Pinglu, as King of Chu.
units.literal: He established Li, son of King Yuan of Chu and Marquis of Pinglu, as King of Chu.

units.zh: 立皇子端為膠西王，子勝為中山王。
units.en: He installed his son Duan as the King of Jiaoxi and his son Sheng as the King of Zhongshan.
units.literal: Installed imperial son Duan as the King of Jiaoxi, son Sheng as the King of Zhongshan.

units.zh: 徙濟北王志為菑川王，淮陽王餘為魯王，汝南王非為江都王。
units.en: He transferred King Zhi of Jibei to Zichuan, King Yu of Huaiyang to Lu, and King Fei of Runan to Jiangdu.
units.literal: He transferred King Zhi of Jibei to be King of Zichuan, King Yu of Huaiyang to be King of Lu, and King Fei of Runan to be King of Jiangdu.

units.en: King Jianglu of Qi and King Jia of Yan both passed away.
units.literal: King Jianglu of Qi and King Jia of Yan both died.

units.en: In the summer of his fourth year, he established the crown prince.
units.literal: Fourth year summer, established crown prince.

units.en: He installed his son Che as King of Jiaodong.
units.literal: Installed imperial son Che as King of Jiaodong.

units.en: On the jiaxu day of the sixth month, he granted a general amnesty throughout the empire.
units.literal: Sixth month jiaxu, granted amnesty to all under Heaven.

units.zh: 後九月，更以（弋）［易］陽為陽陵。
units.en: In the intercalary ninth month, he renamed Yiyang as Yangling.
units.literal: In the intercalary ninth month, he changed Yiyang to Yangling.

units.en: He reestablished the ferry checkpoints and required travel passes for entry and exit.
units.literal: He reestablished the ferry checkpoints and used travel passes for entry and exit.

units.en: In winter, he converted the state of Zhao into Handan commandery.
units.literal: Winter, made Zhao state into Handan commandery.

units.en: In the third month of his fifth year, he built Yangling and the Wei Bridge.
units.literal: In the third month of the fifth year, he built Yangling and the Wei Bridge.

units.zh: 五月，募徙陽陵，予錢二十萬。
units.en: In the fifth month, he recruited settlers for Yangling and gave them 200,000 cash.
units.literal: In the fifth month, he recruited people to move to Yangling and gave them 200,000 cash.

units.zh: 江都大暴風從西方來，壞城十二丈。
units.en: At Jiangdu, a great gale came from the west and damaged twelve zhang of the city wall.
units.literal: At Jiangdu, a great violent wind came from the west and damaged twelve zhang of the city wall.

units.zh: 丁卯，封長公主子蟜為隆慮侯。
units.en: On dingmao, he made Qiao, the eldest princess's son, Marquis of Longlu.
units.literal: On the dingmao day, he enfeoffed Qiao, son of the eldest princess, as Marquis of Longlu.

units.en: He transferred the King of Guangchuan to become King of Zhao.
units.literal: Transferred King of Guangchuan to be King of Zhao.

units.zh: 六年春，封中尉（趙）綰為建陵侯，江都丞相嘉為建平侯，隴西太守渾邪為平曲侯，趙丞相嘉為江陵侯，故將軍布為鄃侯。
units.en: In the spring of his sixth year, he enfeoffed Zhao Wan, the Commandant, as Marquis of Jianling; Jia, Chancellor of Jiangdu, as Marquis of Jianping; Hunye, Governor of Longxi, as Marquis of Pingqu; Jia, Chancellor of Zhao, as Marquis of Jiangling; and Bu, a former general, as Marquis of Shu.
units.literal: In spring of the sixth year, he enfeoffed Commandant Zhao Wan as Marquis of Jianling, Jia the Chancellor of Jiangdu as Marquis of Jianping, Hunye the Governor of Longxi as Marquis of Pingqu, Jia the Chancellor of Zhao as Marquis of Jiangling, and Bu the former general as Marquis of Shu.

units.en: The Kings of Liang and Chu both passed away.
units.literal: The two kings of Liang and Chu both passed away.

units.zh: 後九月，伐馳道樹，殖蘭池。
units.en: In the intercalary ninth month, he had trees cut down along the imperial highways and replanted by Orchid Pond.
units.literal: In the intercalary ninth month, he cut down trees along the imperial highways and planted them by Orchid Pond.

units.zh: 七年冬，廢栗太子為臨江王。
units.en: In the winter of his seventh year, he deposed Crown Prince Li and made him King of Linjiang.
units.literal: In winter of the seventh year, he deposed Crown Prince Li and made him King of Linjiang.

units.en: On the last day of the eleventh month, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: The eleventh month last day, the sun was eclipsed.

units.en: In spring, he pardoned the convicts and bondservants working on the Yangling tomb.
units.literal: In spring, he pardoned the convicts and bondservants working on Yangling.

units.en: Chancellor Qing was dismissed from office.
units.literal: Chancellor Qing was dismissed.

units.zh: 二月乙巳，以太尉條侯周亞夫為丞相。
units.en: On the yisi day of the second month, he appointed Zhou Yafu, Grand Commandant and Marquis of Tiao, as Chancellor.
units.literal: In the second month, on the yisi day, he made Zhou Yafu, Grand Commandant and Marquis of Tiao, Chancellor.

units.zh: 四月乙巳，立膠東王太后為皇后。
units.en: On the yisi day of the fourth month, he established the mother of the King of Jiaodong as Empress.
units.literal: In the fourth month, on the yisi day, he established the mother of the King of Jiaodong as Empress.

units.en: On dingsi, he named the King of Jiaodong crown prince.
units.literal: On the dingsi day, he established the King of Jiaodong as crown prince.

units.en: His name was Che.
units.literal: Named Che.

units.zh: 中元年，封故御史大夫周苛孫平為繩侯，故御史大夫周昌（子）［孫］左車為安陽侯，四月乙巳，赦天下，賜爵一級。
units.en: In the first year of the middle period, he enfeoffed Ping, grandson of the former Grandee Secretary Zhou Ke, as Marquis of Sheng, and Zuoju, grandson of the former Grandee Secretary Zhou Chang, as Marquis of Anyang. On the yisi day of the fourth month, he granted a general amnesty throughout the empire and bestowed one grade of noble rank.
units.literal: In the first year of the middle period, he enfeoffed Ping, grandson of the former Grandee Secretary Zhou Ke, as Marquis of Sheng, and Zuoju, grandson of the former Grandee Secretary Zhou Chang, as Marquis of Anyang. In the fourth month, on the yisi day, he granted amnesty to all under Heaven and bestowed one grade of noble rank.

units.en: He lifted the restrictions imposed by legal disabilities.
units.literal: He abolished legal disabilities.

units.en: There was an earthquake.
units.literal: Earth moved.

units.zh: 衡山、原都雨雹，大者尺八寸。
units.en: Hail fell at Hengshan and Yuandu, with the largest stones measuring one chi and eight cun across.
units.literal: Hail fell at Hengshan and Yuandu, with the largest stones measuring one chi and eight cun.

units.zh: 中二年二月，匈奴入燕，遂不和親。
units.en: In the second month of the second year of the middle period, the Xiongnu invaded Yan, and he therefore abandoned heqin relations.
units.literal: In the second month of the second year of the middle period, the Xiongnu entered Yan, and thereafter he did not maintain heqin relations.

units.en: In the third month, he summoned the King of Linjiang to court.
units.literal: In the third month, he summoned the King of Linjiang to come.

units.en: He died there in the Commandant's office.
units.literal: He then died in the Commandant's office.

units.zh: 夏，立皇子越為廣川王，子寄為膠東王。
units.en: That summer, he made his son Yue King of Guangchuan and his son Ji King of Jiaodong.
units.literal: In summer, he established his son Yue as King of Guangchuan and his son Ji as King of Jiaodong.

units.en: He enfeoffed four marquises.
units.literal: He enfeoffed four marquises.

units.en: On the jiaxu day of the ninth month, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: Ninth month jiaxu, solar eclipse.

units.zh: 中三年冬，罷諸侯御史中丞。
units.en: In the winter of the third year of the middle period, he abolished the office of Censor-in-Chief in the feudal states.
units.literal: In winter of the third year of the middle period, he abolished the feudal lords' Censor-in-Chief offices.

units.zh: 春，匈奴王二人率其徒來降，皆封為列侯。
units.en: In spring, two Xiongnu kings led their followers in surrendering, and both were enfeoffed as full marquises.
units.literal: In spring, two Xiongnu kings led their followers and came to surrender; both were enfeoffed as full marquises.

units.en: In the third month of the fourth year of the middle period, he established the Deyang Palace.
units.literal: Middle fourth year third month, established Deyang Palace.

units.en: There was a great locust plague.
units.literal: Great locusts.

units.en: In autumn, he granted amnesty to convicts working on the Yangling tomb.
units.literal: Autumn, granted amnesty to convicts working on Yangling.

units.zh: 中五年夏，立皇子舜為常山王。
units.en: In the summer of the fifth year of the middle period, he established his son Shun as King of Changshan.
units.literal: Middle fifth year summer, established imperial son Shun as King of Changshan.

units.en: He enfeoffed ten marquises.
units.literal: Enfeoffed ten marquises.

units.zh: 六月丁巳，赦天下，賜爵一級。
units.en: On the dingsi day of the sixth month, he granted a general amnesty throughout the empire and bestowed one grade of noble rank.
units.literal: In the sixth month, on the dingsi day, he granted amnesty to all under Heaven and bestowed one grade of noble rank.

units.en: There were great floods throughout the empire.
units.literal: All under Heaven great floods.

units.en: He changed the title of the feudal lords' chancellors, calling them simply xiang.
units.literal: He changed the title of the feudal lords' chancellors to xiang.

units.en: In autumn, there was an earthquake.
units.literal: Autumn, earth moved.

units.zh: 中六年二月己卯，行幸雍，郊見五帝。
units.en: On the jimao day of the second month of the sixth year of the middle period, he traveled in imperial progress to Yong and performed the suburban sacrifices to the Five Emperors.
units.literal: In the second month of the sixth year of the middle period, on the jimao day, he went in imperial progress to Yong and performed the suburban audience sacrifices to the Five Emperors.

units.en: In the third month, it rained hail.
units.literal: Third month, rained hail.

units.zh: 四月，梁孝王、城陽共王、汝南王皆薨。
units.en: In the fourth month, King Xiao of Liang, King Gong of Chengyang, and the King of Runan all passed away.
units.literal: In the fourth month, King Xiao of Liang, King Gong of Chengyang, and the King of Runan all died.

units.zh: 立梁孝王子明為濟川王，子彭離為濟東王，子定為山陽王，子不識為濟陰王。
units.en: He established Ming, son of King Xiao of Liang, as King of Jichuan; Pengli as King of Jidong; Ding as King of Shanyang; and Bushi as King of Jiyin.
units.literal: He established Ming, son of King Xiao of Liang, as King of Jichuan; his son Pengli as King of Jidong; his son Ding as King of Shanyang; and his son Bushi as King of Jiyin.

units.en: The kingdom of Liang was divided into five parts.
units.literal: Liang was divided into five.

units.en: He enfeoffed four marquises.
units.literal: Enfeoffed four marquises.

units.zh: 更命廷尉為大理，將作少府為將作大匠，主爵中尉為都尉，長信詹事為長信少府，將行為大長秋，大行為行人，奉常為太常，典客為大行，治粟內史為大農。
units.en: He renamed several offices: the Commandant of Justice became Grand Judge; the Chamberlain for the Palace Buildings became Grand Artisan; the Commandant in Charge of Noble Ranks became Commandant; the Chamberlain for Changxin became Lesser Chamberlain of Changxin; the Jiangxing became Grand Changqiu; the Grand Herald became Traveller; the Fengchang became Grand Constant; the Superintendent of Guests became Grand Herald; and the Grain Intendant of the Capital became Grand Minister of Agriculture.
units.literal: He changed the title of the Commandant of Justice to Grand Judge, the Chamberlain for the Palace Buildings to Grand Artisan, the Commandant in Charge of Noble Ranks to Commandant, the Chamberlain for Changxin to Lesser Chamberlain of Changxin, the Jiangxing to Grand Changqiu, the Grand Herald to Traveller, the Fengchang to Grand Constant, the Superintendent of Guests to Grand Herald, and the Grain Intendant of the Capital to Grand Minister of Agriculture.

units.zh: 以大內為二千石，置左右內官，屬大內。
units.en: He made the Grand Interior a two-thousand-shi office and established left and right interior officials under it.
units.literal: He made the Grand Interior a two-thousand-shi office, and established left and right interior officials subordinate to the Grand Interior.

units.en: On the xinhai day of the seventh month, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: Seventh month xinhai, solar eclipse.

units.en: In the eighth month, the Xiongnu invaded Shangjun commandery.
units.literal: Eighth month, Xiongnu entered Shangjun.

units.zh: 後元年冬，更命中大夫令為衛尉。
units.en: In the winter of the first year of the later period, he renamed the Commander of the Palace Gentlemen as Commandant of the Guards.
units.literal: In winter of the first year of the later period, he changed the title of Commander of the Palace Gentlemen to Commandant of the Guards.

units.zh: 三月丁酉，赦天下，賜爵一級，中二千石、諸侯相爵右庶長。
units.en: On the dingyou day of the third month, he granted a general amnesty throughout the empire and bestowed one grade of noble rank. Officials of middle two-thousand-shi rank and the chancellors of feudal lords received the rank of Right Shuzhang.
units.literal: In the third month, on the dingyou day, he granted amnesty to all under Heaven and bestowed one grade of noble rank. Officials of middle two-thousand-shi rank and feudal lords' chancellors received the noble rank of Right Shuzhang.

units.en: In the fourth month, there was a great public celebration with drinking.
units.literal: Fourth month, great assembly.

units.zh: 五月丙戌，地動，其蚤食時復動。
units.en: On the bingxu day of the fifth month, there was an earthquake, and it shook again at breakfast time.
units.literal: In the fifth month, on the bingxu day, the earth moved, and it moved again at early-meal time.

units.zh: 上庸地動二十二日，壞城垣。
units.en: In Shangyong, the earth shook for twenty-two days and damaged the city walls.
units.literal: Shangyong earth moved twenty-two days, damaged city walls.

units.en: On the yisi day of the seventh month, there was a solar eclipse.
units.literal: Seventh month yisi, solar eclipse.

units.en: Chancellor Liu She was dismissed from office.
units.literal: Chancellor Liu She dismissed.

units.zh: 八月壬辰，以御史大夫綰為丞相，封建陵侯。
units.en: On the renchen day of the eighth month, he appointed Wan, the Grandee Secretary, as Chancellor and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Jianling.
units.literal: In the eighth month, on the renchen day, he made Wan, the Grandee Secretary, Chancellor and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Jianling.

units.zh: 後二年正月，地一日三動。
units.en: In the first month of the second year of the later period, the earth shook three times in one day.
units.literal: In the first month of the second year of the later period, the earth moved three times in one day.

units.en: General Zhi attacked the Xiongnu.
units.literal: General Zhi attacked the Xiongnu.

units.en: There was a public drinking celebration for five days.
units.literal: Drinking celebration five days.

units.zh: 令內史郡不得食馬粟，沒入縣官。
units.en: He ordered the Interior commanderies not to feed grain to horses; any such grain was to be confiscated for government use.
units.literal: He ordered that the commanderies under the Interior not feed grain to horses, and that such grain be confiscated into government stores.

units.en: He ordered convicts and bondservants to be dressed in seven-zong cloth.
units.literal: He ordered convicts and bondservants to wear clothing made of seven-zong cloth.

units.en: He ended the practice of using horses to pound grain.
units.literal: He stopped the use of horses for pounding grain.

units.zh: 為歲不登，禁天下食不造歲。
units.en: Because the harvest had failed, he forbade people throughout the empire from eating grain that was not from the current year.
units.literal: Because the harvest did not mature, he forbade all under Heaven from eating grain not produced in the current year.

units.en: He reduced the number of marquises at court and sent them back to their fiefs.
units.literal: He reduced the marquises and sent them to their states.

units.en: In the third month, the Xiongnu invaded Yanmen commandery.
units.literal: Third month, Xiongnu entered Yanmen.

units.en: In the tenth month, he leased out the Changling fields for rent.
units.literal: In the tenth month, he collected rent from the Changling fields.

units.en: There was a great drought.
units.literal: Great drought.

units.zh: 衡山國、河東、雲中郡民疫。
units.en: An epidemic struck the people of Hengshan state and the Hedong and Yunzhong commanderies.
units.literal: The people of Hengshan state and of Hedong and Yunzhong commanderies suffered an epidemic.

units.zh: 後三年十月，日月皆（食）赤五日。
units.en: In the tenth month of the third year of the later period, both the sun and the moon appeared red for five days.
units.literal: In the tenth month of the third year of the later period, the sun and moon were both red for five days.

units.en: There was thunder on the last day of the twelfth month.
units.literal: Twelfth month last day, thunder.

units.en: The sun appeared purple.
units.literal: Sun like purple.

units.en: The five planets moved in retrograde motion and lingered near Taiwei.
units.literal: The five planets moved retrograde and guarded Taiwei.

units.en: The moon passed through the center of the Heavenly Court constellation.
units.literal: The moon passed through the center of the Heavenly Court.

units.en: On the jiayin day of the first month, the crown prince underwent his coming-of-age capping ceremony.
units.literal: In the first month, on the jiayin day, the imperial crown prince underwent the capping ceremony.

units.en: On the jiazi day, Emperor Jing passed away.
units.literal: On the jiazi day, Emperor Xiaojing died.

units.zh: 遺詔賜諸侯王以下至民為父後爵一級，天下戶百錢。
units.en: In his final edict, he granted one grade of noble rank to feudal kings and everyone below them, down to commoners who inherited their fathers' households, and gave one hundred cash to every household in the empire.
units.literal: His testamentary edict bestowed one grade of noble rank on feudal kings and those below them, down to commoners who were heirs to their fathers, and gave one hundred cash to each household under Heaven.

units.zh: 出宮人歸其家，復無所與。
units.en: He released palace women to return to their homes, exempting them from further obligations.
units.literal: He released palace women to return to their homes, restoring the households that had no one to depend on.

units.zh: 太子即位，是為孝武皇帝。
units.en: The crown prince ascended the throne; this was Emperor Wu.
units.literal: The crown prince ascended the throne; this was Emperor Xiaowu.

units.zh: 三月，封皇太后弟蚡為武安侯，弟勝為周陽侯。
units.en: In the third month, he enfeoffed Tian Fen, the Empress Dowager's younger brother, as Marquis of Wuan, and Tian Sheng, another younger brother, as Marquis of Zhouyang.
units.literal: In the third month, he enfeoffed Fen, younger brother of the Empress Dowager, as Marquis of Wuan, and her younger brother Sheng as Marquis of Zhouyang.

units.en: He established Yangling.
units.literal: He established Yangling.

units.zh: 太史公曰：漢興，孝文施大德，天下懷安，至孝景，不復憂異姓，而晁錯刻削諸侯，遂使七國俱起，合從而西鄉，以諸侯太盛，而錯為之不以漸也。
units.en: The Grand Historian says: When Han arose, Emperor Wen practiced great virtue, and the realm rested in peace. By Emperor Jing's time, there was no longer any fear of kings from other surnames. But Chao Cuo cut sharply into the power of the feudal lords, causing the seven states to rise together, join in alliance, and march west. The problem was that the feudal lords had grown too powerful, and Cuo did not proceed gradually.
units.literal: The Grand Historian said: When the Han arose, Emperor Xiaowen practiced great virtue, and all under Heaven cherished peace. By Emperor Xiaojing, there was no longer anxiety over rulers of different surnames, but Chao Cuo sharply curtailed the feudal lords, and so caused the seven states to rise together, unite in alliance, and face west. This was because the feudal lords were too powerful, and Cuo acted without gradual steps.

units.zh: 及主父偃言之，而諸侯以弱，卒以安。
units.en: When Zhufu Yan later proposed his policy, the feudal lords were weakened, and the realm was finally at peace.
units.literal: When Zhufu Yan spoke of it, the feudal lords were thereby weakened, and in the end there was peace.

units.en: Surely the turning point between security and peril lies in policy and planning?
units.literal: The pivot of safety and danger, is it not in planning?
